segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Judge not, that ye be not judged.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother’s eye.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: ¶ Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: ¶ Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: ¶ Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: ¶ Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: ¶ Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: ¶ Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
